## Summary

Add opt-in external Engram placement for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. A persistent CUDA HOST_NUMA/FABRIC owner from [vLLM #64082](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64082) publishes one immutable FP8/E8M0 table generation; independent SGLang P and D workers map it read-only and use SGLang's existing `engram_gather`. Their KV transfer remains on native NIXL. Related to [RFC #64002](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/64002).

```text
ASIS
P TP2 --> its host Engram tables (188.833 GiB)
D TP2 --> its host Engram tables (188.833 GiB)
```

```text
PR
one HOST_NUMA/FABRIC owner (188.833 GiB)
                |--> P TP2: imported GPU views --> existing gather
                +--> D TP2: imported GPU views --> existing gather
```

The measured table extent for two instances changes from 377.666 to 188.833 GiB. This is table backing, not total RSS, page cache or HBM.

## Motivation

Independent P/D instances each load an immutable table that is much larger than either worker's local HBM share. SGLang's existing CPU/peer placements address a single instance's placement and TP layout; the external option removes one P/D backing while keeping the current hash, gather, gate and KV-transfer paths. The compatible owner protocol is provided by the companion vLLM PR. The feature is opt-in and leaves the default placement unchanged.

## Modifications

- `--engram-config` gains `placement=external` with owner endpoint, private token file and expected generation. Workers validate generation, checkpoint config/index hashes, table layout and byte extent before importing read-only FABRIC mappings. A failed unmap retains the owner lease.
- External table parameters are metadata placeholders. The lazy safetensors loader skips the two large table tensors before `get_tensor`, including mixed shards, while loading the smaller weights. Online weight updates reject an attached immutable generation; start a new owner and new workers for a new checkpoint.
- [Runnable SGLang owner/P/D/router/request example](https://github.com/foraxe/sglang/tree/cf1b37ee058b96611faee9a3879e5ee7f1baebe5/examples/engram_shared), [vLLM owner/P/D example](https://github.com/foraxe/vllm/tree/e50524f1ecaea17028a7ec82e9d8e5e0ba4498ea/examples/disaggregated/shared_engram), and `docs/docs/advanced_features/engram.mdx` explain generation handoff, trust boundary and launcher-PID shutdown. [One-host cross-engine launch evidence](https://github.com/foraxe/vllm/tree/a29e4b6c0c511bb11915b8522eecda7e4b687410/evidence/shared_engram_nvl72/launch_close_loop_20261103) records both engines serving sequentially from one owner generation.

## Accuracy Tests

Source head `cf1b37ee058b96611faee9a3879e5ee7f1baebe5`, including pinned SGLang main `99fd01047d67bb249641a8e50282a1a5218afc63`. The real checkpoint's config/index SHA256 and runtime versions are in the evidence. The compatible vLLM owner was at `b4f4a8120` for the matched P/D run; the later VMM package move preserves the tested inference path.

- At the [current inference-path head](https://github.com/foraxe/vllm/tree/31b4a59d17b2691e5c4ab3310599019287ecd040/evidence/shared_engram_nvl72/merge_ready_20261103), ordinary CPU host-table and external-owner P TP2 + D TP2 NIXL arms each completed one warmup and three retained 13-input/32-output requests. Retained text and token IDs matched 3/3 across modes. The owner logged eight attaches/eight normal detaches, no uncertain lease, and owner/P/D top-level exits were zero.
- Earlier component validation matched seven real checkpoint boundary rows per layer exactly through `engram_gather`, changed-ID CUDA Graph replay, and a full-model TP2 decode graph at batch sizes 1 and 2. This is same-host evidence; [original artifacts and source](https://github.com/foraxe/sglang/tree/c15cb25f5fa342b9b653ae4dd0562849e60f2185/evidence/dsv41_shared_engram_fabric) are retained.
- On the final head, seven registered external unit tests, two Engram history tests and all applicable pre-commit hooks passed. The [online-update guard test](https://github.com/foraxe/vllm/tree/9e1186210df05ae93bca32797e8830334e78eb44/evidence/shared_engram_nvl72/merge_ready_followup_20261103) failed before the guard and passed after it. The loader test exercises the actual config-to-iterator path with a mixed shard and ordinary CPU negative control.

### Pinned-baseline VMM port gate

The [VMM-only port evidence](https://github.com/foraxe/vllm/tree/2d2a091119c5cbe8c6b00f56b2ae8999845b01ac/evidence/shared_engram_nvl72/vmm_port_20261103) covers SGLang candidate `e12dfd242`
from pinned main `99fd01047d67` and vLLM owner candidate `91816168b`
from pinned main `6b3488cc97ee`. Their Git trees are exactly equal to the
existing PR heads (`cf1b37ee`, `e50524f1e`) while retaining PR ancestry.
SGLang's importer/mapping moved to `sglang.srt.engram_share.vmm`; no RDMA
files are in either branch. On one four-GB200 host, SGLang P TP2+D TP2
NIXL serving passed with eight normal owner detaches. A synthetic
changed-ID CUDA Graph replay passed, and the full-model TP2 decode graph
served two requests with identical token IDs and four normal detaches.
The isolated runtime reused older wheel assets; this is not a clean-install
or cross-host NVL72 gate.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The preceding [matched 8K local screen](https://github.com/foraxe/sglang/tree/c15cb25f5fa342b9b653ae4dd0562849e60f2185/evidence/dsv41_shared_engram_fabric) was essentially flat: ordinary/shared median TTFT 0.3346/0.3345 s and P-to-D E2E 4.6347/4.6024 s, with one arm order, three retained requests and one C4 wave. The current short-prompt arm gave median wall 4.461/4.361 s. These are diagnostic samples, not a stable speedup or tail-SLO claim. The ordinary CPU control had zero huge-page coverage in the 8K screen. The capacity claim is one avoided 188.833 GiB table backing across P and D.

Only one four-GPU GB200 host was available. Cross-host NVL72/IMEX import, remote Grace latency, 3P1D, image-bearing requests, P/D CUDA graphs, active-graph owner loss, broad model evaluation and production SLOs remain unqualified. The control channel is unencrypted and requires a trusted network.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused registered CPU tests and local full-model gates.
- [x] Update rendered docs and include a runnable example.
- [x] Provide bounded accuracy and speed evidence with source and hardware limits.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style and preserve default behavior.
- [ ] Obtain required human approvals and upstream full CI.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Reviewer requests are open; required approvals remain pending.
2. The PR is ready for repository full CI, but the `run-ci` label is missing. An authorized maintainer must trigger it; local focused tests and GitHub lint have passed.
3. Qualify the cross-host NVL72 claim on a second host before treating this as a validated scale-out result. The branch remains mergeable at GitHub while those gates are open.

+export TOKEN_FILE=/shared/private/engram.token

+`./launch.sh prefill`, `./launch.sh decode`, and `./launch.sh router` in
+separate terminals. Once all three services are ready, use
+`$SGLANG_PYTHON request.py` to send a request through the router.

+Every process needs the same checkpoint identity. The owner and consumers
+need access to the private token file. Stop router, D, and P by sending
+SIGTERM to each launcher PID, not the entire process group. Wait for all
+detach events before stopping the owner. A process-group signal to the
+SGLang workers caused uncertain leases in the local test. For different
+hosts, set routable owner and P/D URLs, adjust GPU IDs and ports, and use
+one IMEX/NVLink domain. Cross-host operation has not been validated yet.

+# One vLLM owner with SGLang P TP2 / D TP2 and the native NIXL router.
+set -euo pipefail
+
+role=${1:?usage: launch.sh owner|prefill|decode|router}
+if [[ "$role" != router ]]; then
+  : "${MODEL_DIR:?set MODEL_DIR to the local DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash checkpoint}"
+  : "${TOKEN_FILE:?set TOKEN_FILE to a private token file shared with consumers}"
+  if [[ ! -r "$TOKEN_FILE" ]]; then
+    echo "TOKEN_FILE is not readable: $TOKEN_FILE" >&2
+    exit 2
+  fi
+fi
+
+sglang_python=${SGLANG_PYTHON:-python}
+owner_endpoint=${OWNER_ENDPOINT:-127.0.0.1:56000}
+owner_port=${owner_endpoint##*:}
+
+run() {
+  if [[ ${DRY_RUN:-0} == 1 ]]; then
+    printf '%q ' "$@"
+    printf '\n'
+  else
+    exec "$@"
+  fi
+}
+
+case "$role" in
+  owner)
+    run "${VLLM_PYTHON:-python}" \
+      -m vllm.distributed.engram_share.vmm.owner \
+      --model-dir "$MODEL_DIR" \
+      --listen-host "${OWNER_BIND_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" \
+      --listen-port "$owner_port" \
+      --token-file "$TOKEN_FILE" --device "${OWNER_DEVICE:-0}"

+"""Attach SGLang Engram gathers to an independent immutable table owner."""

+import logging
+import os

+_RESOURCE_KEY = "external_engram_attachments"

+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.attachments: list[ExternalEngramTable] = []
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def _attachment_state(*, create: bool) -> _AttachmentState | None:
+    buffers = get_resources().buffers
+    if create:
+        return buffers.setdefault(_RESOURCE_KEY, _AttachmentState())
+    return buffers.get(_RESOURCE_KEY)
+

+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as source:
+        while chunk := source.read(8 << 20):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+

+class ExternalEngramTable:
+    """Keep one imported GPU mapping and its owner lease together."""

+    def __init__(
+        self,

+        lease: str,
+        weight_bytes: int,

+        self.connection = connection
+        self.mapping = mapping
+        self.lease = lease
+        self.weight_ptr = mapping.address
+        self.scale_ptr = mapping.address + weight_bytes

+    def close(self) -> None:
+        # Unmap only after the model runner has stopped and the GPU is idle.
+        self.mapping.close()
+        try:
+            self.connection.sendall(
+                json.dumps({"op": "detach", "lease": self.lease}).encode() + b"\n"
+            )
+        finally:
+            self.connection.close()
+
+
+def attach_table(
+    *,
+    endpoint: str,
+    token_file: Path,
+    generation: str,
+    checkpoint_dir: Path,
+    layer: int,
+    rows: int,
+    dim: int,
+    head_sizes: tuple[int, ...],
+    device: int,

+    host, port = endpoint.rsplit(":", 1)
+    connection = socket.create_connection((host, int(port)), timeout=30)
+    lease = None
+    mapping = None

+        if not checkpoint_dir.is_dir():
+            raise ValueError("external Engram needs a local checkpoint directory")

+            "token": token_file.read_text().strip(),
+            "client": {

+                "pid": os.getpid(),
+                "device": device,
+                "layer": layer,
+            },
+        }
+        connection.sendall(json.dumps(request).encode() + b"\n")

+        while not response.endswith(b"\n"):

+        manifest = reply["manifest"]

+            "index_sha256": _sha256(checkpoint_dir / "model.safetensors.index.json"),

+        if isinstance(error, IncompleteTableImportCleanup):
+            connection.close()
+            raise

+                connection.close()

+            with suppress(OSError):
+                connection.sendall(
+                    json.dumps({"op": "detach", "lease": lease}).encode() + b"\n"
+                )

+        raise

+
+def close_attached_tables() -> None:
+    """Called after SGLang has stopped requests and graph replay."""
+    state = _attachment_state(create=False)
+    if state is None:
+        return
+    with state.lock:
+        for attachment in reversed(state.attachments[:]):
+            try:
+                attachment.close()
+            except Exception:
+                logger.exception("Cannot safely detach external Engram table")
+            else:
+                state.attachments.remove(attachment)

+"""Read-only CUDA FABRIC imports for externally owned Engram tables.
+
+The wire layout matches the experimental vLLM shared Engram owner. The owner
+alone allocates HOST_NUMA pages; SGLang maps the same pages into each local GPU
+VA without allocating a table replica.
+"""
+
+import logging
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.utils.cuda_vmm_utils import _get_cuda_driver, check_drv
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class IncompleteTableImportCleanup(RuntimeError):
+    """A failed import may still hold owner pages through a local mapping."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TableHandles:
+    size_bytes: int
+    padded_bytes: int
+    chunk_bytes: int
+    fabric_handles: tuple[bytes, ...]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_wire(cls, value: dict) -> "TableHandles":
+        size = int(value["size_bytes"])
+        padded = int(value["padded_bytes"])
+        chunk = int(value["chunk_bytes"])
+        handles = tuple(bytes.fromhex(item) for item in value["fabric_handles"])
+        expected = (padded + chunk - 1) // chunk if chunk > 0 else 0
+        nodes = tuple(value.get("chunk_numa_nodes", ()))
+        if (
+            size <= 0
+            or padded < size
+            or chunk <= 0
+            or not handles
+            or len(handles) != expected
+            or any(len(handle) != 64 for handle in handles)
+            or (nodes and len(nodes) != len(handles))
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("invalid external Engram table extent")
+        return cls(size, padded, chunk, handles)
+
+
+class TableMapping:
+    """A local VA that remains valid until GPU work and graphs have stopped."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        address: int,
+        table: TableHandles,
+        mapped: list[tuple[int, int]],
+        device: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.address = address
+        self.table = table
+        self._mapped = mapped
+        self.device = device
+        self._closed = False
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._closed:
+            return
+        # A failed synchronization leaves the mapping and owner lease intact.
+        try:
+            torch.cuda.synchronize(self.device)
+        except Exception:
+            raise RuntimeError("cannot quiesce external Engram GPU mapping") from None
+        drv = _get_cuda_driver()
+        while self._mapped:
+            offset, size = self._mapped[-1]
+            check_drv(drv.cuMemUnmap(self.address + offset, size), "cuMemUnmap")
+            self._mapped.pop()
+        check_drv(
+            drv.cuMemAddressFree(self.address, self.table.padded_bytes),
+            "cuMemAddressFree",
+        )
+        self._closed = True
+
+
+def import_table(table: TableHandles, device: int) -> TableMapping:
+    """Import FABRIC handles with driver-level GPU read-only access."""
+    drv = _get_cuda_driver()
+    handle_type = drv.CUmemAllocationHandleType.CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC
+    handles = []
+    address = None
+    mapped: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+    try:
+        for exported in table.fabric_handles:
+            handles.append(
+                check_drv(
+                    drv.cuMemImportFromShareableHandle(exported, handle_type),
+                    "cuMemImportFromShareableHandle",
+                )
+            )
+        address = int(
+            check_drv(
+                drv.cuMemAddressReserve(table.padded_bytes, 0, 0, 0),
+                "cuMemAddressReserve",
+            )
+        )
+        access = drv.CUmemAccessDesc()
+        access.location.type = drv.CUmemLocationType.CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_DEVICE
+        access.location.id = device
+        access.flags = drv.CUmemAccess_flags.CU_MEM_ACCESS_FLAGS_PROT_READ
+        for index, handle in enumerate(handles):
+            offset = index * table.chunk_bytes
+            size = min(table.chunk_bytes, table.padded_bytes - offset)
+            check_drv(drv.cuMemMap(address + offset, size, 0, handle, 0), "cuMemMap")
+            mapped.append((offset, size))
+            check_drv(
+                drv.cuMemSetAccess(address + offset, size, [access], 1),
+                "cuMemSetAccess",
+            )
+        return TableMapping(address, table, mapped, device)
+    except BaseException as error:
+        cleanup_error = None
+        if address is not None:
+            for offset, size in reversed(mapped):
+                try:
+                    check_drv(drv.cuMemUnmap(address + offset, size), "cuMemUnmap")
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    cleanup_error = exc
+            try:
+                check_drv(
+                    drv.cuMemAddressFree(address, table.padded_bytes),
+                    "cuMemAddressFree",
+                )
+            except Exception as exc:
+                cleanup_error = exc
+        if cleanup_error is not None:
+            error.add_note(f"external Engram cleanup failure: {cleanup_error}")
+            raise IncompleteTableImportCleanup(
+                "external Engram import cleanup failed; owner lease must be retained"
+            ) from error
+        raise
+    finally:
+        for handle in handles:
+            result = drv.cuMemRelease(handle)
+            error = result[0] if isinstance(result, tuple) else result
+            if error != drv.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS:
+                # Once mapped, propagating this error would lose the local VA
+                # before the caller can keep its owner lease alive.
+                logger.error("cuMemRelease(imported handle) failed: %s", error)
